versions.changelog:
Initial release of Sprint Retrospective Facilitator.

- Guides teams through structured sprint retrospectives with actionable outcomes.
- Supports multiple retro frameworks: Start/Stop/Continue, 4Ls, Mad/Sad/Glad, Sailboat, and DAKI.
- Collects, groups, and prioritizes feedback to generate action items with owners, deadlines, and success criteria.
- Produces shareable retro reports and tracks patterns across sprints to highlight recurring issues.
- Offers flexible usage via full facilitation flow, quick feedback processing, and comparative theme analysis.
